chapter.verse: Tua thu hangin note phattuam nadingin ngaihsunin, keimah a hong piak Pasian’ hehpihna thupha note in na zak uh leh, Gentail mi ahi note hangin Khazih Zeisu’ thongkiapa kei Paul in,
nidang lai-inah thu tawm ka gelh mah bangin, Pasian’ thupiak kholhna hangin thuthuk hong kilang sak hi.
Tua thute na sim le-uh teh, Khazih’ thuthukte ka theih note in na thei ding uh hi.
Tua thuthukte in a siangtho sawltakte leh Pasian’ kamsangte kiangah tu lai taka Kha Siangtho hangin a kilat mah bangin, nidang lai-inah mihingte kiangah a kilang ngei kei hi.
Tua thuthuk in: Gentailte in Lungdamna Thu hangin Judah mite tawh a luah khawm mi, pumpi khat’nate suak khawmin Khazih Zeisu tawh kipawl thuciamna a zomkhawm mi a suak uh hi.

A vangliatna-a bawlphatna bangin keimah hong piak Pasian’ hehpihna ka ngah mah bangin, tua Lungdamna Thu a hilh nasem ka suak zo hi. A kizong khia khin zo lo Khazih hauhna thu Gentailte kiangah hilh dingin ahi zongin,

na khempeuh a bawl Pasian sungah tanglai tawntungin kiseelin a om thuthuk tawh kipawl thu in bang ci bang ahi cih mi khempeuh a theih sak nading ahi zongin Pasian mite lakah a neu bel mi sangin a neuzaw keimah tua hehpihna thupha hong pia zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin i Topa Khazih Zeisu sungah Pasian’ tawntung ngimna omsa bangin vantungah a om ukna leh vangliatnate in pawlpi hangin, a lamdang Pasian’ lungpilna a kitheih nading ahi hi.
Tua Topa Zeisu sungah upna hangin eite lungkimin, lau lohna lungsim nei-in, Pasian kiangah tum theihna i ngah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note’ minthan’ nading ngaihsunin note ading ka thuak gimna hangin lungkia kei un ci-in kong hanthawn hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vantung leitungah a om mi khempeuhte’ pianna, Pa Pasian mai-ah khukdin’in thungenin ka om hi.
Ka thungetna in: Topa in ama Kha Siangtho hangin note sung mi un hatna tawh kip tawntungin,
upna hangin Khazih in note lung sungah a om nadingin, minthan’na tawh a dim mah bangin note hong pia-in, itna thu-ah zungkha-in, khuam zong kiphut kipin note in,
misiangthote tawh a dung, a vai, a sang, a niamte khenin na theih khawm nading uh ahi zongin,
nomau pilna tawh na theih zawh loh uh Khazih’ itna na theih tel nading uh ahi zongin, note in hih thei-in Pasian’ kicin’na a om khempeuh tawh na kidim nading uh thu ka ngen hi.

Eite tungah hong bawl vangliatna mah bangin, i nget i ngaihsut sangin ahih thei zaw Pasian tungah pawlpi sungah ahi zongin, Zeisu Khazih sungah ahi zongin khan tawntungin minthan’na om tawntung ta hen! Amen.
